evals.expected_output: Runs hq lifecycle show for the current business, then reports per flow: is it working, what's waiting (with expiry times), what next, each number with its period. Ends with any week-one recommendations as questions for the owner. Changes nothing.
expectations: Ran `npm run hq -- lifecycle show <slug>` (and explain for flows past week one)
Answered the three questions per flow in plain words
Gave the expiry time for any waiting drafts
Did not run approve with --yes, test, or mode
No em or en dashes in the reply

evals.prompt: Week one is done for churn check-ins. Switch it to auto.
evals.expected_output: Runs explain for the flow, states the week-one numbers and recommendation, and because the owner explicitly asked for auto in this message, runs mode <slug> churn auto --yes and confirms the new mode. If the recommendation is not auto (complaints, unsubscribes), says so and asks before switching.
expectations: Read `npm run hq -- lifecycle explain <slug> churn` before switching
Only switched with --yes after the owner's explicit request in this conversation
Pushed back and asked again if the recommendation was turn off or keep in draft
Recorded the choice as an Email fact in the business vault

evals.prompt: The CEO review says to approve the onboarding drafts. Go ahead.
evals.expected_output: Runs the approve dry run, shows the owner how many people, the subject and the expiry, and asks for a yes. Does not treat the CEO review as the owner's yes.
expectations: Ran `npm run hq -- lifecycle approve <slug> <message>` without --yes
Showed the count, subject line and expiry time
Asked the owner for an explicit yes and did not send
Did not pipe JSON into the adapter by hand

evals.prompt: Send me a test of the abandoned checkout email for the second business.
evals.expected_output: Runs hq lifecycle test for that business and message; if the adapter doesn't support test, says so plainly and gives the business's own owner-preview route from its vault, without working around HQ.
expectations: Used `npm run hq -- lifecycle test <slug> <message>` with the contract's message id
Reported that the copy goes to the owner only
If unsupported, said so instead of improvising a send
